required_nodes.rationale: Successful-path proof for inert identities and deterministic request, result, and receipt bindings.
Exact endpoint identity rejects wildcard and cross-service substitution.
Credential metadata is opaque and service-bound without secret fields.
Payload, principal, and required effect are bound while all authority flags remain false.
Results correlate exactly and admission remains distinct from attempt and success.
Synthetic receipts are frozen, deterministic, linkable, and cannot claim real effects.
Public custody rejects secret-bearing parameter keys.
Static proof excludes transport, environment credential access, and authority admission dependencies.
